description: The 8 h corpus soak (soak.py, perf-corpus/long-day-soak.json): one bench launch plays agent-swarm, dev-loop and browse-heavy in a loop, each replay's checkpoint digests checked, then resets to one workspace and idles 5 minutes. Main hangs over 250 ms per hour (debug.hangs count250), footprint growth per hour of every app process and of the app alone (least-squares over the gap footprints at one workspace, the warm-up pass left out), idle wakeups per second in each gap (proc_pid_rusage, no socket call inside) and Chromium process failures per hour (debug.crashes chromium_total).
not_measurable: agent-swarm, dev-loop and browse-heavy are planned, not recorded: soak.py plays only recorded stories (tasks 117, 118 and 119, then a lab capture of their checkpoint digests). Remove this field in the change that records the last of them.
